summary: Layer 1B expansion for the grid/power-availability node found three US-listed candidates with plausible direct or second-order AI data-center exposure. Powell Industries is the cleanest equipment-vendor read-through because its official releases cite medium-voltage switchgear demand, AI/data-center activity, record backlog, and a post-quarter data-center order above $400 million. IES Holdings has direct data-center electrical/technology infrastructure exposure with management stating that data-center demand was a primary growth driver. MYR Group is a specialty electrical contractor with transmission, distribution, substation, and data-center facility services exposure; its AI link is more second-order and needs backlog/customer verification. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
